Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 1.Overview

Terra (marketed to end users as Scent Plus) is a mobile companion application built to automate the

setup, scheduling, and monitoring of Wi-Fi-connected scent and fragrance dispenser devices for home

and business use.

The application gives users a single, mobile-first workspace to bring a new device onto their home network,

configure a spraying schedule, monitor device status, and keep firmware up to date — all from one phone,

with no separate hub, screen, or PC required.

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 2.Business Context

Organizations and consumers deploying screenless smart-home devices typically need to:

• Onboard a new Wi-Fi device onto a home or business network without a direct physical connection

• Configure and adjust an operating schedule remotely, without buttons or a display on the device

• Monitor consumable levels, battery, and overall device health at a glance

• Keep device firmware current without returning the unit or connecting it to a computer

• Diagnose a lost connection quickly and get clear guidance to restore it

Handling this manually for screenless IoT hardware is cumbersome and inconsistent. Terra centralizes

the entire device lifecycle — from provisioning through scheduling, monitoring, and servicing — into a

single, purpose-built mobile app.

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 4.Functional Modules > 4.1Device Discovery & Network Setup

Users open the app directly to a network list screen that scans nearby Wi-Fi networks in real time. The

screen highlights the target device as it is detected and guides the user straight into the pairing flow —

there is no separate sign-in step, so setup starts immediately.

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 4.Functional Modules > 4.2Guided Wi-Fi Provisioning

• Select a home Wi-Fi network and enter its password

• The app securely transmits the network credentials to the unprovisioned device over the air

• The device automatically joins the home network without ever being directly connected to the phone

• The app verifies the connection and proceeds straight into the device dashboard

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 4.Functional Modules > 4.3Device Dashboard & Monitoring

• Central dashboard surfaces battery level, remaining scent capacity, estimated days of scent
remaining, and current firmware version

• An automatic health check confirms the device is reachable before live data is shown

• Clear visual status indicators alert the user immediately if the connection is lost

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 4.Functional Modules > 4.4Spray Schedule Management

• Weekly, day-by-day schedule editor for configuring spray timing and frequency

• Each schedule entry can be activated, deactivated, or removed independently

• Schedule changes are sent directly to the device and take effect immediately

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 4.Functional Modules > 4.5Device Modes & Manual Controls

• Demo mode triggers an immediate spray on demand, for testing and verification

• Sleep mode places the device into a low-power state when it isn't needed

• Manual controls are available for dispenser configuration

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 4.Functional Modules > 4.6Firmware (OTA) Updates

• The app automatically compares the device's current firmware version against the latest available
version

• When a newer version is available, the user is prompted to update

• Firmware is delivered directly to the device over the local network, with clear progress and completion
feedback

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 4.Functional Modules > 4.7Connection Health & Diagnostics

• Continuous background monitoring keeps the app aware of the device's connection state at all times

• Users are alerted immediately if the device becomes unreachable, with guidance to restore the
connection

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 6.Reporting & Analytics

The dashboard provides an at-a-glance operational view, including:

• Battery level and remaining scent capacity

• Estimated days of scent remaining

• Current firmware version, with an update prompt when a newer version is available

• Live device connection status

• A weekly schedule overview, with each entry's active/inactive state

Every reading on the dashboard reflects the device's current, live state — the app always shows what the

device itself is reporting, refreshed each time the dashboard is opened.

Section: COMPANY PROFILE > 8.Value Delivered

• Eliminates the need for screens or buttons on the physical device by centralizing setup and control in

• Reduces manual effort in Wi-Fi provisioning and day-to-day device operation

• Streamlines schedule management from anywhere on the home network

• Simplifies firmware servicing with guided, in-app over-the-air updates
